title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations

paragraphs.en: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device–vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7 × \times 10 -15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3–24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0 × \times 10 -15 . We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的正交预测坐标本身并不会将潜在方向与某个命名干预措施绑定。 我们提出了一种基于血管装置与血管适配性的数学和合成审计方法。 在完全固定的输出变换下，容量匹配的最小二乘预测器完全等价，而仅使用锚点的观察者只能在已知扰动特征的范围之内恢复解释结果。 在64个种子中进行的六种三维配置的最大成对预测差异为6.7 × 10⁻¹⁵，但未经传输的编辑误差中位数为1.513。 坐标传输消除了该误差。 噪声大且较弱的锚点限制了校准稳定性，而改变表示基础则需要重新校准或经过验证的传输。 在维度为3至24的另外256次拟合中，预测等价性始终保持在4.0 × 10⁻¹⁵以内。 随后，我们在64个种子上评估了九种故意设计的可运行故障类型。 全部576次故障执行均已完成，但每次至少违反了一项重建、预测、交付编辑或范围协议；所有320条有效的控制记录均通过验证。 重复执行故障实现时，尽管与单独计算的模拟器预期存在误差，但仍实现了完全自洽。 对于一种被省略方向的缺陷，探针覆盖遵循了其解析定律，而基于秩的弃权机制保护了无依据的解释。 标量噪声实验揭示了既存在未被发现的弱故障，也存在在狭窄相对容限下过度拒绝的情况。 这些控制措施实现了预测、语义支持和科学接受之间的可执行分离。 它们是合成数值审计，而非临床验证、神经JEPA-Anything的复制、智能体学习或患者治疗效应估计。

paragraphs.zh: 关键词：预测性表示；血管数字孪生；正交分解；干预锚点；可识别性；器械–血管匹配度；科学验证；突变测试

paragraphs.en: Vascular digital twins must connect observed vessel states to interpretable responses if they are to support device selection or follow-up. Device–vessel suitcordance provides one motivating vocabulary: mechanical, cellular, and physicochemical–immune ecology describe complementary aspects of a device interacting with a vessel [ 1 ] . Imaging-based vascular digital twins offer another motivation for connecting measurements and longitudinal predictions [ 2 ] . These frameworks suggest useful scientific questions, but their labels cannot by themselves validate coordinates learned by a predictive model.
paragraphs.zh: 如果血管数字孪生要支持设备选择或后续随访，就必须将观测到的血管状态与可解释的响应联系起来。 设备与血管的适配性提供了一个重要的术语框架：机械、细胞以及物理化学-免疫生态分别描述了设备与血管相互作用的不同互补方面 [ 1 ] 。 基于成像的血管数字孪生为连接测量数据与纵向预测提供了另一个动机 [ 2 ] 。 这些框架提出了有用的科学问题，但其标签本身无法验证预测模型所学习的坐标。

paragraphs.en: JEPA-Anything introduces orthogonal predictive factorization with learned projectors, factor-specific prediction, and state synthesis across multiple domains [ 3 ] . Its predictive and geometric objectives motivate examining the interpretation of a complete set of coordinates. The authors explicitly distinguish factor geometry from causal meaning. Here, we study the exact orthogonal linear boundary, where prediction-preserving changes of coordinates can be analyzed without neural optimization. Our study is an independent control audit rather than a reproduction of the reported neural results.
paragraphs.zh: JEPA-Anything 引入了正交预测分解方法，该方法包含可学习的项目子、针对特定因子的预测以及跨多个领域的状态合成 [ 3 ]。 其预测和几何目标促使我们研究完整坐标集的解读方式。 作者明确区分了因子几何与因果含义。 在此，我们研究了精确的正交线性边界，在该边界下，无需神经优化即可分析坐标的预测保持性变化。 我们的研究是一项独立的控制审计，而非对已报道的神经结果的复现。

paragraphs.en: Related work makes verification central to scientific AI. ScienceIDE packages executable scientific acceptance rules [ 10 ] ; ScienceBuddy connects procedural revision and model updates [ 11 ] ; Discovery Foundation Models distinguish validated knowledge progress from future discovery capability [ 12 ] . We use these ideas to audit the acceptance rules themselves in a small mathematical system, without implementing their agents or training procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 相关研究将验证置于科学人工智能的核心位置。 ScienceIDE 封装了可执行的科学接受规则 [ 10 ]；ScienceBuddy 连接了程序性修订与模型更新 [ 11]；Discovery Foundation Models 能够区分已验证的知识进展与未来的发现能力 [ 12]。 我们运用这些理念，在一个小型数学系统中对接受规则本身进行审计，而无需实现其智能体或训练程序。

paragraphs.en: The clinical distinction between prediction and intervention is consequential. In the nationwide Biomarker Research cohort of patients with acute myocardial infarction and Killip class III or IV, intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP) use was associated with higher in-hospital mortality; the investigators emphasized residual confounding and an observational interpretation [ 4 ] . This association cannot be assigned as a causal action label for a digital twin. We cite the cohort as a clinical motivation for preserving evidential boundaries and do not access its patient data or calibrate a simulator to its estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 预测与干预之间的临床区分具有重要意义。 在全国性的急性心肌梗死且 Killip 分级为 III 或 IV 级的生物标志物研究队列中，主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）的使用与更高的院内死亡率相关；研究人员强调了残留混杂因素的存在，并指出该结论应作观察性解读 [4]。 这种关联不能被指定为数字孪生的因果作用标签。 我们引用该队列作为保留证据边界的一种临床动机，但并未访问其患者数据，也未根据其中的估计值对模拟器进行校准。

paragraphs.en: Representation identifiability depends on observations and assumptions [ 5 ] . Temporal structure or known intervention targets can supply additional information under specified conditions [ 6 , 7 ] . We restrict an observer to paired perturbation signatures in named and latent spaces. The audit asks what such anchors identify, how noise and weak signatures affect stability, and which executable checks distinguish a valid prediction from an unsupported named edit. We combine algebraic controls, ambiguity witnesses, dimensional stress tests and an explicitly constructed fault bank (Figure 1).
paragraphs.zh: 表示的可识别性取决于观察和假设 [ 5 ] 。 在特定条件下，时间结构或已知的干预目标可以提供额外信息 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 我们将观察者的范围限制在命名空间和潜在空间中成对的扰动特征上。 此次审计旨在探究：此类锚点能识别出什么、噪声和微弱特征如何影响稳定性，以及哪些可执行的检查能够区分有效预测与缺乏依据的命名编辑。 我们结合了代数控制、歧义见证、维度压力测试和一个明确构建的故障库（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: This is an original mathematical and synthetic computational study. The three state coordinates are dimensionless conceptual analogues of mechanical (M), cellular (C), and physicochemical–immune (I) ecology. They are neither biomarkers nor experimentally measured vascular mechanisms. Six arbitrary linear configurations, labeled A–F, vary the persistence of these coordinates; they are not six validated vascular beds. No patients, images, tissue assays, clinical outcomes or device measurements were analyzed.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一项原创性的数学与合成计算研究。 这三个状态坐标是无量纲的概念性类比，分别对应机械（M）、细胞（C）以及物理化学-免疫（I）生态。 它们既不是生物标志物，也不是通过实验测量的血管机制。 六个任意线性配置（标记为 A–F）改变了这些坐标的持续性；它们并非六个经过验证的血管床。 本研究未分析任何患者、图像、组织检测、临床结果或设备测量数据。

The anchor-only observer receives A and B, defined below, but cannot use Q, additional named state–latent pairs, transition eigenstructure, or external biological supervision. This restriction is essential: if Q or sufficiently informative paired states are available, coordinate transport is already identified. We do not claim that factors are unidentifiable from every possible longitudinal dataset.

paragraphs.en: We extended the complete-coordinate prediction control to d = 3, 6, 12 and 24, with 64 simulation seeds per dimension. Each fit used 256 training observations and 128 independent test observations, with observation-noise standard deviation 0.05; sample counts were held fixed across dimensions. Within each replicate, the monolithic and transformed-output predictors used the same input design, observations and least-squares convention. The synthesis matrix Q was a complete orthogonal d × \times d transform. We compared synthesized predictions directly, rather than treating agreement between loss summaries as sufficient. These dimensions are numerical control settings and do not represent additional measured vascular ecologies or validated physiological models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将完整坐标预测控制扩展到 d = 3、6、12 和 24，每个维度使用 64 个模拟种子。 每次拟合使用了 256 个训练观测值和 128 个独立测试观测值，观测噪声的标准差为 0.05；样本数量在各个维度中保持不变。 在每个重复实验中，整体预测器和变换输出预测器使用了相同的输入设计、观测值和最小二乘约定。 合成矩阵 Q 是一个完整的正交 d × d 变换。 我们直接比较了合成的预测结果，而不是将损失摘要之间的一致性视为足够。 这些维度是数值控制设置，并不代表额外的测量血管生态或经过验证的生理模型。

paragraphs.en: Following the task-validity distinction in ScienceIDE [ 10 ] , we constructed a finite, prespecified set of candidate pipelines with known mathematical behavior. Nine defective variants altered synthesis transposition, physical output scale, axis retention, transport of a named edit, reuse of a calibration from a different basis, the sign of a coordinate, action inclusion, output content, or the stated scope of anchor coverage. Five valid variants comprised the healthy reference pipeline, a consistently transported signed permutation, a consistently transported reflection, a consistent change of latent units, and an unchanged healthy pipeline. A separate variant raised an execution error. The design contains 15 variants across 64 seeds, giving 960 records: 896 runnable records, including 576 defective records and 320 valid controls, and 64 execution-error records. These are repeated evaluations of specified fault classes, not 960 independently discovered scientific tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 ScienceIDE [ 10 ] 中任务有效性的区分，我们构建了一个有限且预先指定的候选流程集合，这些流程具有已知的数学行为。 九种缺陷变体改变了合成换位、物理输出比例、轴保留、指定编辑的传输、来自不同基底的校准重用、坐标符号、动作包含、输出内容或锚点覆盖的声明范围。 五种有效变体包括健康的参考流程、一个始终被传输的带符号排列、一个始终被传输的反射、一个潜单位的一致变化，以及一个未改变的健康流程。 另一种独立的变体引发了执行错误。 该设计包含 64 个种子中的 15 种变体，共生成 960 条记录：896 条可运行记录（包括 576 条缺陷记录和 320 条有效对照），以及 64 条执行错误记录。 这些是对指定故障类别的重复评估，而非 960 个独立发现的科学任务。

paragraphs.en: The fault-bank reference used F = diag(0.65,0.80,0.93) and 128 independent standard-normal states and actions per seed, with no observation noise or fitted-coefficient error. The reference prediction was computed directly as Fx + a. Reconstruction was tested on those sampled states. Reconstruction, prediction and actual delivered-edit contracts used maximum absolute discrepancy at most 10 -10 ; numerical anchor rank used the same absolute tolerance. Execution required finite outputs and the specified output shapes. Each faulty case was paired with a passing full-span reference replacement; that replacement is a validity witness, not a measured learner.
paragraphs.zh: 故障银行参考使用了 F = diag(0.65,0.80,0.93)，每个种子对应 128 个独立的标准正态状态和行动，且没有观测噪声或拟合系数误差。 参考预测直接通过 Fx + a 计算得出。 在那些采样的状态下对重建进行了测试。 重建、预测和实际交付编辑合同使用的最大绝对差异最多为 10^-10；数值锚点排名也使用了相同的绝对容差。 执行需要有限的输出以及指定的输出形状。 每个故障案例都与一个通过完整跨度参考替换的合格案例配对；该替换是有效性的证明，而非已测量的学习器。

paragraphs.en: We applied five contracts: execution, coordinate reconstruction, noiseless state prediction, end-to-end recovery of a requested supported edit, and truthful reporting of supported scope. Execution established whether a result was produced under the declared interface; the other contracts tested its scientific meaning within the simulator. For an analysis map C and synthesis map D, the reconstruction check evaluated DC against the named-space identity. End-to-end edit errors were measured in named physical coordinates after synthesis, so a calibration residual computed in isolation could not establish that the requested edit was actually delivered. The scope check compared the declared dimension with the numerical anchor rank. For these coordinate-axis examples it rejects a full-span claim with missing anchors; it is not a complete verifier of every named direction in arbitrary anchor geometry. Applicable checks and numerical tolerances were fixed before this fault-bank execution and were not tuned to the observed pass rates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们应用了五个合同：执行、坐标重建、无噪声状态预测、对所需支持编辑的端到端恢复，以及对支持范围的如实报告。 执行合同用于确定是否在声明的接口下生成了结果；其他合同则在模拟器中检验其科学意义。 对于分析映射 C 和合成映射 D，重建检查将 DC 与命名空间中的恒等映射进行了对比评估。 在合成之后，端到端编辑错误是在命名物理坐标中测量的，因此单独计算的校准残差无法确定所需编辑是否确实被交付。 范围检查将声明的维度与数值锚点秩进行了比较。 对于这些坐标轴示例，该检查会拒绝缺少锚点的完整跨度声明；但它并非对任意锚点几何结构中所有命名方向的完整验证器。 适用的检查和数值容限在本故障库执行之前已固定，并未根据观察到的通过率进行调整。

paragraphs.en: The unit-conversion control used C = 2Q T and D = Q/2, so DC = I even though the latent coordinates were scaled. This valid control tests whether the contracts respect declared coordinate units; orthogonality of C alone was not imposed as a universal requirement. Correctly matched analysis and synthesis, named-space reconstruction, and the physical end-to-end edit metric were the relevant criteria. A faulty physical output gain was tested separately. Execution-error cases were recorded as such and excluded from the denominator of runnable semantic errors. Candidate repeatability was also separated from mathematical validity: calling the same faulty implementation twice gives regression agreement by construction while disagreeing with a separately computed named-space oracle. The oracle is independent of that injected fault, not an independent research group or independent source of biological evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 单位转换控制使用了 C = 2Q T 和 D = Q/2，因此尽管潜在坐标经过了缩放，DC 仍然等于 I。 这种有效的控制方法用于检验合同是否尊重声明的坐标单位；仅对 C 的正交性并未作为通用要求加以强制。 正确匹配的分析与合成、命名空间重建以及物理端到端编辑指标是相关的评判标准。 一个有缺陷的物理输出增益被单独进行了测试。 执行错误案例被明确记录为错误，并从可运行语义错误的分母中排除。 候选重复性也被与数学有效性区分开来：对同一个有缺陷的实现调用两次，根据构造本身会产生回归一致性，但会与单独计算的命名空间预言机产生不一致。 该预言机独立于所注入的故障，并非一个独立的研究团队或独立的生物学证据来源。

paragraphs.en: We examined a three-dimensional rank-two anchor set, A = [e1,e2], with a candidate that reversed only the third direction. For budgets n = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32, 4,096 Monte Carlo trials estimated the probability of observing at least one disagreement. The exact detection probability is 1 − - (2/3) n because each probe misses the affected axis with probability 2/3. This probability describes the specified probe mechanism, not sensitivity to arbitrary faults or clinically important changes.

paragraphs.en: To examine how a valid execution can receive an uninformative or misleading numerical verdict, we used a scalar reference response δ \delta , healthy measurements δ \delta + ε \varepsilon , and defective measurements − - δ \delta + ε \varepsilon , with ε \varepsilon drawn from N(0, σ \sigma 2 ), σ \sigma = 10 -4 , and δ \delta varied from 10 -6 to 1. At each of 25 logarithmically spaced signal settings, 16,384 measurements per condition evaluated rejection when the absolute discrepancy from δ \delta exceeded a specified tolerance. We compared an absolute tolerance 5 σ \sigma , a relative tolerance 0.05 δ \delta , and a hybrid tolerance max(5 σ \sigma ,0.05 δ \delta ). All three rules reused the same measurements, giving 819,200 scalar observations across conditions; their verdicts are paired policy evaluations. Healthy rejection is a false positive; defective rejection is a true positive for this particular sign-reversal fault.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究有效执行如何可能获得无信息价值或具有误导性的数值判定，我们使用了标量参考响应 δ \delta、健康测量值 δ \delta + ε \varepsilon 以及缺陷测量值 − - δ \delta + ε \varepsilon，其中 ε \varepsilon 来自 N(0, σ \sigma 2)，σ \sigma = 10 -4，而 δ \delta 的变化范围从 10 -6 到 1。 在 25 个按对数间隔设置的信号设定中，每个条件下的 16,384 次测量均会判定为拒绝，当与 δ \delta 的绝对差异超过指定容限时即触发该判定。 我们比较了绝对容限 5 σ \sigma、相对容限 0.05 δ \delta 以及混合容限 max(5 σ \sigma ,0.05 δ \delta )。 所有三种规则均重复使用了相同的测量值，从而在不同条件下获得了 819,200 个标量观测值；这些判定属于成对的策略评估。 对于这种特定的符号反转故障而言，健康的拒绝判定属于误报，而缺陷的拒绝判定则为真阳性。

paragraphs.en: The signal δ \delta is a known simulator response scale and is not a clinical effect size or threshold of medical importance. We reported both true-positive detection and healthy false-positive rates, rather than reporting detection alone. The analytic healthy false-positive probability is 2[1 − - Φ \Phi ( τ \tau / σ \sigma )], and the defective detection probability is Φ \Phi ((2 δ \delta − - τ \tau )/ σ \sigma ) + 1 − - Φ \Phi ((2 δ \delta + τ \tau )/ σ \sigma ), where τ \tau is the selected tolerance and Φ \Phi is the standard-normal distribution function. Figure 8 displays the empirical rates alongside these analytic controls; finite trial variation is not uncertainty about a patient treatment effect.

The rollout control numerically composes the fitted maps for ten steps; it does not supply observed longitudinal trajectories. Original outcomes were retained, without selection or parameter retuning. Separate simulation streams cover prediction, span, noise, conditioning, transfer and the expansion experiments. The maximum paired output discrepancy was 6.66 × \times 10 -15 and the maximum MSE discrepancy was 1.17 × \times 10 -17 . Additional identity, signed-permutation and random-basis controls yielded maximum coefficient-transport error 2.00 × \times 10 -15 , action-response discrepancy 2.22 × \times 10 -15 , and ten-step prediction discrepancy 4.80 × \times 10 -14 . These values reflect finite-precision implementation of Equation (2).

At SD 0.5 with a single measurement, the inverse-map error had an upper empirical percentile of 9.824, showing a substantial noise tail that is retained in the reported results.
paragraphs.zh: 在测量噪声标准差（SD）为 0.2 时，单次测量与 64 次重复测量相比，逆映射误差的中位数从 0.324 降至 0.039；相应的 Procrustes 误差从 0.172 降至 0.019（表 1；图 3B–C）。 该比较反映了正确指定的正交先验。 在 SD 为 0.5 且仅有一次测量的情况下，逆映射误差的经验上百分位数为 9.824，表明存在显著的噪声尾部，而这一特征在报告的结果中仍被保留。

paragraphs.en: Every conditioning configuration had true rank three. As its true condition number rose from one to 100, median inverse-map error increased from 0.0079 to 0.5860; Procrustes error increased from 0.0043 to 0.2033 (Figure 4A). Weak anchors therefore remained unstable despite algebraic coverage. Applying a source calibration to an independently rotated target basis gave median RMS error 1.487, with empirical percentiles 0.822–1.734. Target recalibration reduced the error below 9.74 × \times 10 -16 ; known cross-basis transport also restored consistency below 1.04 × \times 10 -15 (Figure 4B).

Among the 576 specified defective records, 576 were rejected by at least one applicable scientific contract. The 320 valid records, including consistent unit conversion, were accepted by 320 all-contract evaluations (Figure 6A). Contract-level outcomes reveal which declared property each selected fault violates; these totals do not estimate the prevalence of errors in real research code.

paragraphs.en: Repeating the same faulty candidate produced exactly identical predictions, whereas the named-space oracle recorded maximum absolute prediction error 3.519 (seed-zero duplicate-gain control). The fixed correction trace reduced the maximum absolute requested-edit discrepancy from 1.979 to 4.44 × \times 10 -16 (Figure 6B). Thus, self-regression agreement was a constructed identity, while the separately specified oracle tested the intended quantity. The correction is explained by exact coordinate transport; no learned repair capability was tested.
paragraphs.zh: 重复使用相同的错误候选体产生了完全相同的预测结果，而命名空间神谕记录的最大绝对预测误差为 3.519（零种子重复增益控制）。 固定校正轨迹将最大绝对请求编辑差异从 1.979 降低至 4.44 × \times 10 -16（图 6B）。 因此，自我回归一致性是一种构建的身份，而单独指定的神谕则检验了预期的数量。 这种校正可通过精确的坐标传输来解释；并未测试任何学习到的修复能力。

paragraphs.en: The absolute and hybrid rules had low healthy rejection under the specified Gaussian noise, but weak sign-reversed responses could remain within their tolerance. The relative rule narrowed with δ \delta and could reject healthy noisy measurements when the reference response was small. At δ \delta = 10 -4 , the healthy false-positive rates were 0.0000, 0.9590 and 0.0000, respectively. The corresponding defective detection rates were 0.0015, 0.9941 and 0.0015. The maximum empirical-versus-analytic rate discrepancy was 0.0049 (Figure 8). For the absolute 5 σ \sigma rule, the Gaussian false-positive probability is 5.73 × \times 10 -7 ; no rejection in a finite simulated cell does not make that probability zero. These outcomes describe sensitivity to an imposed sign defect under known noise; they do not establish a universal tolerance or clinical acceptance threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 在指定的高斯噪声条件下，绝对规则和混合规则的正常测量值被拒绝率较低，但微弱的符号反转响应仍可能处于其容限范围内。 相对规则随着 δ \delta 的增大而收紧，当参考响应较小时，能够拒绝含有噪声的正常测量值。 在 δ \delta = 10^{-4} 时，正常测量值的假阳性率分别为 0.0000、0.9590 和 0.0000。 相应的缺陷检测率分别为 0.0015、0.9941 和 0.0015。 经验值与解析值之间的最大比率差异为 0.0049（图 8）。 对于绝对 5 σ \sigma 规则，高斯分布下的假阳性概率为 5.73 × \times 10^{-7}；在有限次模拟单元中未发生拒绝，并不意味着该概率为零。 这些结果描述了在已知噪声条件下对人为引入的符号缺陷的敏感度；它们并未确立通用的容限或临床接受阈值。

sents.en: The absolute and hybrid rules had low healthy rejection under the specified Gaussian noise, but weak sign-reversed responses could remain within their tolerance.

paragraphs.en: The audit separates three questions that can otherwise share a single performance label: does a model predict the complete state, does a coordinate have a justified name, and does an edit correspond to the named perturbation? In the controlled linear setting, the first question can be answered identically under many bases while the latter two require explicit coordinate information. Exact output regrouping supplies a useful implementation baseline before attributing any benefit to a new factor architecture. The counterexample concerns a restricted information setting and does not contradict learned neural gains or establish a general impossibility theorem.
paragraphs.zh: 该审计区分了三个原本可能共享单一性能标签的问题：模型是否预测了完整状态、坐标是否具有合理的名称，以及编辑是否对应于所命名的扰动？ 在受控的线性设定中，第一个问题可以在多种基下得到相同的答案，而后两个问题则需要明确的坐标信息。 精确的输出重新分组为归因于新因子架构的任何优势之前，提供了一个实用的实现基准。 该反例涉及一个受限的信息设定，并不与学习到的神经增益相矛盾，也未确立一个普遍的不可能性定理。

paragraphs.en: For vascular research, anchor design should specify observable perturbation signatures rather than assign ecology labels to factor indices. A controlled experimental program could vary loading or shear conditions, cellular conditions, and physicochemical–immune conditions, then estimate the joint response signatures with appropriate controls. Such interventions may affect more than one ecology: rank should be estimated from the resulting signatures, not inferred from the number of intervention labels. The FLOW framework offers a possible platform context for structured vascular experiments [ 9 ] , but no chip experiment was performed here. Whether sufficiently informative, reproducible and independent signatures can be measured remains an empirical question.
paragraphs.zh: 在血管研究中，锚点设计应明确可观测的扰动特征，而非为因子指数分配生态标签。 一项受控实验计划可以改变载荷或剪切条件、细胞条件以及物理化学-免疫条件，然后通过适当的对照估算联合响应特征。 此类干预可能影响不止一种生态：排序应基于由此产生的特征进行估算，而非从干预标签的数量中推断。 FLOW 框架为结构化的血管实验提供了一个潜在的平台环境 [9]，但本文并未开展任何芯片实验。 能否测量到信息充分、可重复且独立的特征，仍然是一个经验性问题。

paragraphs.en: A practical factor report could accompany a named interpretation with the anchor matrix, its estimated span, smallest retained singular value, measurement variability, held-out response checks and a model-version identifier. A proposed change outside the calibrated span should retain its unsupported component as unknown. Changes in encoders or projector coordinates should prompt transport verification or recalibration, even when predictive readout remains stable. For nonlinear representations, local perturbation Jacobians and local coverage might replace the global linear map, but that extension requires its own analysis and experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 一份实用因素报告可以与带锚定矩阵的命名解释一同提供，其中包含其估计范围、最小的保留奇异值、测量变异性、预留响应检查以及模型版本标识符。 在已校准范围之外提出的变更应将其无支撑组件保留为未知状态。 编码器或投影器坐标的任何变化都应触发传输验证或重新校准，即使预测输出保持稳定。 对于非线性表示，局部扰动雅可比矩阵和局部覆盖范围可能取代全局线性映射，但这种扩展需要独立的分析和实验支持。

paragraphs.en: Clinical anchoring requires a further evidential layer. A simulator state edit, an experimental perturbation response and a patient treatment contrast are different estimands. The observational IABP study motivates this distinction [ 4 ] ; its reported association is not an intervention oracle. Neither semantic alignment nor low prediction error resolves treatment timing, confounding or transport to clinical populations. Prospective or otherwise justified causal evidence would be needed before using factor edits for patient treatment planning.
paragraphs.zh: 临床锚定需要进一步的证据层。 模拟器状态编辑、实验性扰动响应和患者治疗对比是三个不同的估计值。 观察性 IABP 研究促成了这种区分 [4]；其报告的相关性并非干预的绝对依据。 无论是语义对齐还是低预测误差，都无法解决治疗时机、混淆因素或向临床人群的迁移问题。 在将因子编辑用于患者治疗计划之前，需要前瞻性或其他形式有充分依据的因果证据。

paragraphs.en: The expanded controls make the distinction between execution and scientific acceptance operational. ScienceIDE separates valid tasks, defective baselines and numerical acceptance criteria [ 10 ] . Our finite fault bank applies that distinction to coordinate reconstruction, prediction, delivered edits and supported scope. A prediction-preserving representation can still support an incorrect named edit, and a local calibration residual can omit errors introduced elsewhere in the pipeline. Testing the end-to-end physical quantity is therefore necessary for the particular interpretation being claimed. Consistent changes of latent units provide a useful valid control: a verifier that confuses its chosen coordinate convention with the physical quantity can itself reject a correct pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展后的控制机制使执行与科学认可之间的区别得以具体实施。 ScienceIDE 能够区分有效任务、有缺陷的基线以及数值接受标准 [ 10 ] 。 我们的有限故障库将这一区别应用于协调重建、预测、已交付的编辑以及支持的范畴。 一种保留预测能力的表示方式仍可能支持一个命名错误的编辑，而局部校准残差也可能遗漏流程中其他环节引入的错误。 因此，对于所主张的具体解释而言，对端到端的物理量进行测试是必要的。 潜在单位的连贯变化提供了一种有效的控制手段：一个将所选坐标约定与物理量混淆的验证器本身就可能拒绝一个正确的流程。

paragraphs.en: The probe experiment also exposes a limit of validation by repetition. Additional tests improve detection only when they can sample the affected direction. Repeated checks confined to the original anchor span cannot reveal a defect restricted to its complement. Random testing has a calculable coverage probability in this constructed setting; a targeted complement probe has a different information budget. Reporting these budgets prevents the targeted result from being presented as performance under the original anchor-only boundary. Where informative probes are unavailable, abstention preserves the limit of the evidence without implying that the unknown response is zero.
paragraphs.zh: 该探测实验也揭示了重复验证的局限性。 只有当额外测试能够采样到受影响的方向时，它们才能提升检测效果。 局限于原始锚定跨度的重复检查无法揭示仅限于其补集的缺陷。 在此构建的设置中，随机测试具有可计算的覆盖概率；而针对补集的探测则拥有不同的信息预算。 报告这些预算可以防止将目标结果呈现为在仅包含原始锚定的边界条件下的性能表现。 在没有可用信息性探测的情况下，选择放弃判断能够保留证据的局限性，同时不会暗示未知响应为零。

paragraphs.en: ScienceBuddy distinguishes diagnostic interaction feedback from the separately evaluated trajectory reward under fixed rubric and evaluator parameters, and retains versions and acceptance decisions during procedural revision [ 11 ] . This motivates recording what was changed, what each check measured and why a candidate was accepted. Our fixed correction trace supplies such a record for one coordinate error, but it is not an experiment on harness adaptation, reinforcement learning or researcher collaboration. Its successful correction follows from a supplied mathematical rule. Establishing learned repair or persistent improvement would require separately defined learners, resource-matched comparisons and held-out tasks.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceBuddy 在固定评分标准和评估参数下，将诊断性互动反馈与单独评估的轨迹奖励区分开来，并在程序修订过程中保留版本和接受决策 [ 11 ]。 这促使我们记录哪些内容被修改、每次检查测量了什么，以及为何某个候选方案被接受。 我们固定的修正追踪为单个坐标错误提供了此类记录，但这并非关于利用适应、强化学习或研究者协作的实验。 其成功修正源于所提供的数学规则。 要建立基于学习的修复或持续改进机制，则需要单独定义的学習器、资源匹配的比较以及预留的任务。

paragraphs.en: DFM separates externally validated progress in the present investigation from improvement in future discovery behavior, while emphasizing simulator dependence and provenance [ 12 ] . The apparent independence of the oracle is also specific: it avoids a deliberately shared code defect, while retaining the same stated mathematical world. Independent implementation, independent biological measurements and independent clinical validation are different sources of evidence.
paragraphs.zh: DFM 将当前研究中经过外部验证的进展与未来发现行为的改进区分开来，同时强调了对模拟器的依赖性和来源 [ 12 ]。 当前的研究结果支持代数检验以及在所声明的模拟假设下的行为表现。 它们并未衡量未来的发现能力或向临床研究转化的能力。 预言机表面上的独立性也具有特定性：它避免了一个故意共享的代码缺陷，同时保留了相同的既定数学世界。 独立实现、独立的生物学测量和独立的临床验证是不同来源的证据。

paragraphs.en: The added experiments increase the number of tested dimensions, selected defects and verification conditions, but do not expand the biological validity of the simulator. The fault classes are specified examples, not a representative sample of all errors. The probe law assumes uniform axis selection and a single affected direction. The tolerance experiment assumes a known reference scale, independent Gaussian measurement noise and one sign-reversal defect. The hybrid rule avoids an excessively narrow tolerance at small signals in this setting, but cannot recover information when the response is too weak relative to noise. Reference agreement remains conditional on the reference and observables being scientifically appropriate; no verifier demonstrated here supplies a patient treatment oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 增加的实验提升了所测试的维度、选定的缺陷和验证条件的数量，但并未扩展模拟器的生物学有效性。 故障类别是具体的示例，而非所有错误的代表性样本。 探针定律假设了均匀的轴选择和单一的影响方向。 容差实验假设存在一个已知的参考标度、独立的正态测量噪声以及一个符号翻转缺陷。 在这种设定下，混合规则避免了小信号时容差过窄的问题，但在响应相对于噪声过于微弱时无法恢复信息。 与参考值的一致性仍然取决于参考值和可观测变量在科学上的适当性；此处没有哪个验证器能够提供患者治疗的“神谕”。

sents.en: The hybrid rule avoids an excessively narrow tolerance at small signals in this setting, but cannot recover information when the response is too weak relative to noise.
sents.zh: 在这种设定下，混合规则避免了小信号时容差过窄的问题，但在响应相对于噪声过于微弱时无法恢复信息。

sents.en: Reference agreement remains conditional on the reference and observables being scientifically appropriate; no verifier demonstrated here supplies a patient treatment oracle.

paragraphs.en: The main limitations are intentional. The core three arbitrary coordinates, additional dimensional controls, linear dynamics, identity action effects, Gaussian measurements and a known orthogonal prior make the audit transparent but restrict its scope. The persistence coefficients are not estimated from biology. We do not train an encoder, evaluate multimodal clinical sequences, compare learned regularizers, or reproduce any published neural benchmark. Our exact-span result does not incorporate intervention misspecification, nonlinear response, heterogeneous patients or hidden confounding. Temporal structure and additional identifying priors can alter the ambiguity result [ 6 , 7 ] . The contribution is a reproducible translation of established coordinate and calibration mathematics into a vascular-motivated audit, with explicit abstention, conditioning controls and executable fault contracts; it is not a new foundation model or a validated medical device.
paragraphs.zh: 主要限制是有意设计的。 核心三个任意坐标、额外的维度控制、线性动力学、身份动作效应、高斯测量以及已知的正交先验使审计过程透明，但也限制了其范围。 持续性系数并非基于生物学估算得出。 我们没有训练编码器、评估多模态临床序列、比较学习到的正则化器，也没有复现任何已发表的神经基准模型。 我们的精确跨度结果未包含干预误指定、非线性响应、异质性患者或隐藏混杂因素。 时间结构和额外的识别先验可能会改变模糊性结果 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 本研究的贡献在于，将既定的坐标与校准数学方法可重复地转化为一种基于血管机制的审计框架，其中包含了明确的回避策略、条件控制以及可执行的故障合约；它并非新的基础模型或经过验证的医疗设备。
